chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 460: The Grave of an Otherworld Ancestral God
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen explores a cursed mountain range in the Death World, encountering swarms of undying rats that have consumed the flesh of an Otherworld Ancestral God. He discovers the Ancestral God's skeletal remains and a mysterious jade book.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 460: An Ancestral God's Corpse Awakens
og_description: In the depths of the Death World, Xiao Chen faces uncanny rats that cannot die and an Ancestral God skeleton that fights without a soul.
twitter_title: World of Immortality 460: The Undying Rats
twitter_description: Xiao Chen battles immortal rats and an Ancestral God skeleton in a cursed mountain range. What dark secret lies beneath?
